Server-side TPU/QUIC transaction reassembly and publish API.

# Purpose
This header file defines the `fd_tpu_reasm` interface for server-side TPU/QUIC transaction reassembly. It declares the data structures, state values, size and alignment rules, and public functions used to create, join, query, prepare, fragment, publish, and cancel transaction reassembly slots. The code also defines helper macros for reassembly memory sizing and an inline hash function for the `fd_tpu_reasm_key_t` stream key. Overall, the file provides the API for receiving QUIC stream fragments, rebuilding transaction messages, and publishing complete messages to the mcache for downstream use.
